boundaries: This artifact is provenance for release-prep work, not founder approval.
This artifact does not mark Vaporize v0.0.1 internally releasable.
Legacy project.yml read compatibility is a bridge for comparison and migration, not the forward source-of-truth claim.
Generated project.pkl import specimens are migration evidence, not .xcodeproj generators.
Generated transitional AppleProjectSpec YAML is migration evidence, not a checked-in project.yml replacement or .xcodeproj generator.
Shared Xcode workspace product-cache reuse is a cache lookup and build-invocation slice; CUJ-19 adds candidate-path warm/missing discovery, not automatic .xcworkspace graph membership discovery.
Xcode workspace scheme listing is a command/parser/receipt slice; CUJ-20 does not prove product paths, cache warmth, fleet coverage, or large-workspace runtime behavior.
The why-vaporize benchmark baseline is local release-prep evidence and must not be presented as fleet performance proof.

The first runtime sample is backfilled and references ephemeral SwiftPM build artifacts; it proves the target shape, not automatic Vaporize emission, durable artifact retention, or per-feature-flag size comparison.

The wrkstrm-core build-config composition correction identifies existing sources of truth; Vaporize does not yet automatically join registry, identifier, app-artifacts, and release-feature records into app-facing samples.
The wrkstrm app-minimums target-level slice inspects project.yml targets; Vaporize does not yet join registry, identifier, app-artifacts, and release-feature records across the fleet.
Concourse build comparison is one-specimen evidence and must not be generalized to the whole fleet without additional receipts.

Project target discovery reads AppleProjectSpec routing facts; it does not build, install, generate .xcodeproj world-state, parse .xcworkspace graph membership, warm the maintained workspace cache, or prove fleet parity.

CUJ-22 proves SwiftPM CLI resource-bundle install behavior and product metadata sidecars; it does not prove app bundle packaging, Bundle.main product metadata, Sparkle appcast generation, update signing, or public update delivery.
